text: If $W$ is a subspace of $\real^n$ with orthogonal complement $W^\perp$, then any $n$-dimensional vector $\bvec$ can be uniquely written as $$ \bvec = \bhat + \bvec^\perp $$ where $\bhat$ is in $W$ and $\bvec^\perp$ is in $W^\perp$. The vector $\bhat$ is the orthogonal projection of $\bvec$ onto $W$ and $\bvec^\perp$ is the orthogonal projection of $\bvec$ onto $W^\perp$.
